meta.title: ZCode Dispatch Console
meta.description: Dispatch and monitor headless ZCode processes in the Harness (single-writer mutual exclusion, usage & context, plan channel)

ui.title: ZCode Dispatch Console
ui.headerTip: Open or hide the ZCode dispatch panel
ui.noFileLocks: (no file locks: jobs did not declare write, using whole-repo lock)
ui.dispatchThinkingHint: Follow channel = dispatch with the channel's thinking setting (set in the Channels section); a concrete level is enforced for this dispatch (new sessions only)
ui.chanThinkingHint: Channel default thinking: Agent decides = the dispatching agent picks a concrete level per task; a concrete level is a hard rule for dispatched agents (dispatches without an explicit level follow it; new sessions only)
ui.thinkingHint: Agent decides = the dispatching agent picks a concrete level per task; a concrete level is enforced (new sessions only; --resume keeps the session level)
ui.thinkingStaleHint: This level is not in the current model declaration (the model level table may have changed) — dispatch would be rejected by the runner; pick a valid level
ui.rerunTitle: Re-send the original prompt in the same session (--resume; without a sessionId it hands off)
ui.continueTitle: Send a NEW instruction into the same session (--resume + new prompt)
ui.continueNoSession: This task has no sessionId, so it cannot be continued (use Rerun to hand off instead)
ui.emptyOffline: Host not connected: no process data (live data needs the Remote wiring)
ui.localNote: Local usage (verifiable): ledger-aggregated 5h / week / today windows
ui.engineWeekUsed: Engine week used (engine-local DB total, not plan usage)
ui.planQuotaPending: Plan quota remaining: not wired — no such method on the CLI RPC surface (app-server usage/stats is local-used only); defer to the ZCode client
ui.jobStalledHint: No runner heartbeat/output for over 150s: it may be stuck on an upstream request, MCP connect or a lock. Kill and re-dispatch, or use action=tail for the last output.
ui.chanOfflineHint: Host not connected: channel/model come from the host Remote face and unlock once connected
ui.timedOutWatchdog: watchdog kill (still running after timeoutMin+120s grace)
ui.handoffConfirm: Channel switch = handoff rerun: a new session starts and the unfinished part is handed over
ui.fallbackEnableTitle: Auto fallback: click to enable/disable. When enabled, quota-exhausted / not-entitled / signing-required pauses hand off to the target chosen below (downstream quota is consumed)
ui.fallbackHint: Same option logic as the Channels section above: empty model = that channel's default model; "Agent decides" resolves via ZCode's default rule. New sessions only.
ui.fallbackOfflineHint: Host not connected: fallback settings live in the host work dir and unlock once connected
ui.switchTitle: ZCode dispatch master switch: click to toggle (writes collab/zcode-dispatch.switch.json, effective for all sessions)
ui.switchHintOffline: Host not connected: run zcode-switch.mjs in a terminal to toggle
ui.switchOffBlocked: Dispatch master switch is off: all dispatch entries are rejected; re-enable via the title-bar switch or zcode-switch.mjs
ui.writePh: files to write (comma/newline separated; empty = whole repo)
ui.writeHint: locks only these files, so tasks writing other files can run in parallel
ui.lockNoneHint: no lock (only when no write conflict is possible)
ui.lockScopeHint: locks only the files listed above; empty locks the whole repo (exclusive)
